title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal of ctr:4600070530 - part:350020, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our expected volume is 4580 pieces per year, and we propose committing for 24 or 36 months instead of 12.

Our should-cost estimate cost:350020 puts the unit cost of part:350020 at EUR 403.21 before margin. Our forecast fc:350020@2026-09 records a 10.3 % change, so this business keeps growing.

The attached term sheets combine a longer commitment and flexible payment terms with a fair price. Since the price change exceeds 2 %, could you take them to your pricing committee for an authorized review? Please also tell us your earliest lead time and whether a cheaper variant of the converter is available.

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal of ctr:4600070530 - part:350020, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month commitment and are willing to accommodate the requested 45-day payment terms. Based on this extended contract duration, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 429.95. 

Consequently, our Angebot comprises a price of €429.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Our engineering and logistics departments will address your inquiries regarding alternative variants and lead times separately. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Application Engineering:
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 15.94 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 11.23 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 7.02 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Frame agreement part:350020 - longer commitment and payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the revised offer and for verifying our data.

Your scorecard sc:70530@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 84.6 %, below what we expect from an A-class strategic supplier.

You mentioned flexibility on payment, volume and contract length. We can commit 4580 pieces per year for 36 months, which gives you planning security through 2029. The attached term sheets combine this commitment with different payment terms.

The price change exceeds 2 %, so could you please submit these sheets to your pricing committee at its next meeting for an authorised review? Could you also tell us whether a measure to improve on-time delivery is planned?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement part:350020 - longer commitment and payment terms
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. 

As an alternative, we are pleased to accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms at an adjusted unit price of EUR 430.68: a price of €430.68 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

As to the delivery record data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have verified your data regarding our delivery performance, and our logistics department is implementing measures to improve our on-time delivery rate. 

As our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027, we cannot submit your term sheets to a pricing committee for further discounts. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 - request for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for the revised offer and for the planned delivery measures.

We can firmly commit 4580 pieces per year for 36 months, which gives you secure volume through 2029. We will also keep 90-day payment terms.

The attached term sheets reflect this commitment. Because the change exceeds your 2 % approval limit, could you please put them to your pricing committee at its next meeting for an authorised review?

Once approved, could you make the 36-month package your primary standing offer? Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant of the converter or a shorter lead time is available?

Best regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
